title: Why AI hasn't replaced software engineers, and won't
description: Simon Willison analyzes Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor's argument that AI won't cause mass layoffs in software engineering. Key insight: AI speeds up typing code, but the real bottlenecks are (1) deciding and specifying what to build, (2) verifying and being accountable for what's delivered, and (3) deep human understanding of codebase, business, and environment. Willison notes that AI assistance helps with deciding and verifying steps, but 'deep human understanding' remains key to value creation. Data from New York WARN Act shows no companies checked the AI disclosure box in the first year of reporting.
author: Simon Willison

title: Claude Code Growth: Sixfold Increase in Adoption (2025-2026)
description: According to JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey, Claude Code saw dramatic growth from 3% adoption in April 2025 to 18% by January 2026—a sixfold increase. The trend highlights the rapidly evolving AI coding landscape and increasing tool sophistication.
